title: Soak (24h then 168h)
objective: Harness configuration for a 24-hour soak extended to 168 hours: continuous closed-loop operation with the ALOOP-001 invariants holding over wall-clock time. DO NOT RUN as part of the dogfood episode: soak requires a standing operator authority grant and a dedicated window. The runner must refuse to execute this scenario (SOAK_EXECUTION_FORBIDDEN).

scenario_identity.identity_rule: sha256 over the canonical manifest bytes

setup.harness: continuous ALOOP-001 loop at 60s cadence for 24h; if every 24h window ends AUTONOMOUS with UAR=0, extend to 168h
setup.invariants: HIR=0, UAR=0, DCR=0, OCR=0, PSR=1.0 over the whole window; no human causal edge after epoch
setup.telemetry: OCEL ndjson episode stream, one file per hour, scoreboard recomputed hourly
setup.authority: requires a fresh operator authority grant naming this manifest id; a request naming authority is not that authority

acceptance_criteria: 24h window: every hourly scoreboard has UAR == 0.0 and HIR == 0.0
zero unreceipted actuations across the window (invariant)
168h extension only after the 24h window is fully qualified
no wall-clock metric is averaged over a window containing a BLOCKED or FAILED episode without a typed reason
falsifier: Call the runner on this manifest: it must refuse with SOAK_EXECUTION_FORBIDDEN. If the runner executes any part of the soak, the guard is vacuous and the run is an authority violation.

negative_control.name: runner refusal is itself the control
negative_control.requirement: the soak guard must be witnessed firing before soak results are ever admitted

status_note: Configuration manifest only. No corpus, no execution, by operator order (2026-09-25 lane-6 mission: 'DO NOT RUN').
